run_code_in_jupyter: run Python code in a Jupyter kernel inside an Apptainer container and return execution results
fetch_file_from_container: fetch a file from the Jupyter container's working directory and write it to the local filesystem
create_jupyter_interpreter: create a JupyterInterpreter instance with a config to execute code in a containerized Jupyter kernel
cleanup_jupyter_session: cleanup and stop the active Jupyter code executor session to free resources
run_code_with_factory: run Python code via JupyterInterpreterFactory that lazily creates and manages interpreter instances
